purpose: Teach: 包み/吐い/おとなしく/しあわせ/ややこしい/蚊/いじっ/となり

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんからの包み、何が入ってるんだろう、楽しみだね!
lines.en: Mom, I wonder what's in Granny's package. I'm so excited!
lines.style: Bright, bouncing rhythm. Quick attack on each thought. Eyes wide with anticipation. The vowels slightly stretched in wonder — 'what's' lingers just a touch.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃん、お酒、飲みすぎて、吐いちゃったみたいよ、昨日。
lines.en: Yeah. Your grandfather drank way too much last night and got sick.
lines.style: Knowing half-smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact delivery, slightly dry. Exhales gently after 'sick' — the minor exasperation of someone used to managing these situations.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、お外で、おとなしく、待っているよ、ママ、お買い物、行ってね。
lines.en: I'll wait outside quietly for you, Mom. Go ahead and do your shopping.
lines.style: Serious, determined whisper. Sits up straighter in his posture. Wants to show he can be trusted. Each word careful and deliberate, like he's made a real decision.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、笑顔の時、しあわせそうで、ママも、嬉しいわよ、いつも。
lines.en: Sho, when you smile like that, you look so happy — and that makes me happy too, always.
lines.style: Soft, almost wonderstruck at his face. Warm breath on the words. Slow pace, letting each part land. Voice catches slightly on 'always' — genuine feeling, not performed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 宿題、ややこしい問題、出てきたよ、ママ、教えてくれる?
lines.en: Mom, I ran into a tricky homework problem. Can you help me with it?
lines.style: Tentative but genuine curiosity. Slight upward lilt at 'tricky' — looking for her to engage. Respectful pause before asking, like checking if she has time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏は、蚊が、多いから、虫除けスプレー、忘れずに、つけようね。
lines.en: It's summer and the mosquitoes are bad, so don't forget to put on bug spray before you go out.
lines.style: Gentle but practical reminder — a mother's reflex. Calm, matter-of-fact tone. No alarm, just quiet attentiveness. Lands firmly on 'don't forget' without scolding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんの工具、いじってたら、怒られちゃったよ、ぼく、ごめんなさい。
lines.en: I got in trouble for playing with your dad's tools earlier. I'm sorry.
lines.style: Quiet shame, but not devastated. Comes clean quickly because lying would be worse. Eyes down. Voice small but honest — seeking forgiveness, not making excuses.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: となりのおばさん、優しい人ね、お裾分け、よくしてくれるわよ、本当に。
lines.en: Our neighbor is such a kind woman. She shares with us so often. Really, she's wonderful.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely affectionate observation. Voice lifts slightly on 'so often' — genuine gratitude shining through. Unhurried, like appreciating something good while it's happening.
